audit.whatIsWrong: Lane was labelled FAV at 5.5/10 on a 26.67% win rate, and the chart gave Lucian four stages to Ambessa's zero.
audit.why: The packet flags the same contradiction, and the page's own whys[4] and whys[6] describe Ambessa winning level 6 and the item game.
audit.corrected: diff HARD, 7.5/10, Ambessa carry threat 7.5/10; rows 2, 4 and 6 corrected in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Lucian spike with generic Culling copy; no real cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s, blinks to the farthest champion in a line at 1250 range, suppresses on arrival and then stuns. Lacerate is 13s at rank 1, Repudiation 18s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Ambessa and the three real cooldowns now anchor the mid-lane advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every field referred to a fabricated ability called "Dash Chain"; Repudiation's shield and Drakehound's Step's auto reset were absent.
audit.why: Ambessa's real abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). Repudiation shields her while bracing and deals increased damage if it blocked non-minion damage — so eating your opening burst makes her slam hit harder. Drakehound's Step grants her next attack bonus range, damage and attack speed.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout the fields I could reach; shield-baiting and the auto-reset wind-up tell added.

audit.why: Public Execution's derived grounding and heal flags are not supported by Riot's description (blink, suppress, slam, stun only) — the mirror slice removed the same invented armour-pen and healing claims from Ambessa's page.
audit.corrected: No grounding, healing or anti-heal claim written for her ultimate.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Q-W-E chunks her, but she dashes around skillshots and Lacerate slows your exit — a skill check, not a free window.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Dash Chain — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Bait Lacerate (13s) and Repudiation (18s), then W-mark, double-shot and dash out before her CC comes back around.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Public Execution suppresses through your E and Repudiation finishes the job — do not duel her at 6.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Your first item trades evenly with her single-item body if you keep it short — she can dash out and reset, so neither owns it.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: She out-stats you at two items and weaves her dashes around your skillshots — play safe, group, and stop taking the 1v1.

edits.before: Win the first ten minutes hard enough that his mid game never matters. Nothing here works through Dash Chain — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Win the first ten minutes hard enough that her mid game never matters. Nothing works through Public Execution (130s at rank 1) — plan every step-up around it.

edits.before: Ambessa wins by landing Dash Chain, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Ambessa wins by landing Public Execution, suppressing you out of Relentless Pursuit, and finishing with Repudiation's shielded slam.

edits.before: Dashing IN to start a trade with Dash Chain still loaded — you've spent the exit, and everything he saved now lands on a stationary marksman.
edits.after: Dashing IN with Public Execution loaded — you've spent your exit, and a suppression landed on a stationary marksman is the whole kill.

edits.before: - Ambessa Dash Chain: matchup-defining — Her passive dash weaving — fight when the chain is spent. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Ambessa Public Execution: matchup-defining — a 130s blink and suppression; step up only once it is spent. - Repudiation (18s) shields her and hits harder if it blocked your burst — bait it out. - Drakehound's Step resets her auto — read the wind-up.

edits.before: Her passive dash weaving — fight when the chain is spent. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Repudiation (18s) shields her mid-brace — bait the shield out, then commit your string.

edits.before: Ambessa spends Dash Chain early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Ambessa spends Public Execution early — the closest thing this lane has to a guarantee.

edits.before: That is Ambessa’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Drakehound's Step resets her auto — step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: Track Ambessa’s Dash Chain: Her passive dash weaving — fight when the chain is spent. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Public Execution: a 130s blink to the farthest target in a line that suppresses, then stuns — E cannot answer it.

notes: "Dash Chain" is a fabricated ability and appeared in tldr, loading, focus.text, breakdown.trading, report[1], report[3] and report[9] as well; I replaced it everywhere the length band allowed. focus.text is only 18 characters so the applier may skip it under the 25-char rule — if it does, that field still reads "Ambessa Dash Chain" and needs a manual pass. No grounding or healing claim written for Public Execution: the derived flags contradict Riot's text.
